description: Tenant-managed Forward API connection used only by the app backend

ForwardAccessProfile.description: Declared Forward RBAC boundary enforced by the app

constraints.customMessage: Name must be between 1 and 100 characters

baseUrl.description: Normal Forward tenant URL, such as https://fwd.app. The app adds /api internally; existing values ending in /api remain supported.

constraints.customMessage: URL must be between 1 and 2048 characters
Enter an HTTPS Forward URL without a path; an existing /api suffix is also accepted

networkId.description: Exact Forward network managed by this connection

constraints.customMessage: Network ID must be between 1 and 128 characters

credentialVaultId.description: APP_ENGINE-scoped Dynatrace Credential Vault username/password entry for the dedicated Forward service identity

constraints.customMessage: Credential Vault ID must be between 20 and 160 characters
Credential Vault ID must use the CREDENTIALS_VAULT- entity form

forwardAccessProfile.description: Declared Forward RBAC profile; the app enforces the corresponding workflow

approvedLibraryQueryIds.displayName: Approved Forward Library NQE query IDs
approvedLibraryQueryIds.description: Comma or newline separated FQ_ query IDs that a Read Only connection may execute (maximum 5000 characters)

constraints.customMessage: Approved query ID list must be no longer than 5000 characters

approvedQueryDigests.description: Comma or newline separated sha256 digests for reviewed arbitrary NQE queries (maximum 5000 characters)

constraints.customMessage: Approved query digest list must be no longer than 5000 characters

schemaConstraints.customMessage: A Forward API connection with the same name already exists
